## Open

### T-099 — Party suite: portal person-browse test is flaky on a cold page compile

> _2026-09-16 · realm/blong-party · open_

portal.play.ts 'open and close person browse tab' fails on the first attempt with locator.waitFor
5000ms exceeded and passes on retry (reported as 1 flaky in every run). Diagnosed as a cold
dev-server compile of the person browse page racing the shared BLONG_ELEMENT_TIMEOUT of 5s; the ACL
filter on party.person (extra correlated subquery) makes the query slower, so the margin is thinner.
Fix options: warm the route before the test, or raise BLONG_ELEMENT_TIMEOUT - a framework-wide
decision, so it was left as is.

### T-100 — Organization ACL rows in the party test seed are dropped silently

> _2026-09-16 · realm/blong-party · open_

Adding two deny rows (principal Admin, action party.organization.find / .get, target FinServe
Solutions Ltd, targetType organization, targetKind scope) next to the three person denies made the
person rows insert while the organization rows did not, with no error in the log - deleting all
non-wildcard rows and re-running recreated only the three person rows. The same row shape works when
written through access.acl.add at runtime (which is how test.acl.flow does it now). Worth
investigating: the seed dispatch path for a rule whose target type is not a person, and whether a
failing row aborts the rest silently.
